title: Tur wiñu ko jox balaa muy judd
intro: Xalaatal barab bu sell bu fees dell ak ñaan gu dëggu ginaaw ay at yu bari yu ñu xaar. Ci luñu dul gis la tontu bu yor tur wuñu musul joxe ci àdduna, dige xam-xam bu tàmbalee ci at yu njëkk ya ak dundu gu ànd ak jaamu Yàlla, yërmaande ak sell.
clues: Yàlla ci boppam moo ma tuddee laata may juddu, tur wu kenn musul a tudd lu jiitu man.
Ñu jox ma ndimbal ci samay waajur yu mag, ndax dañu jàppoon ni doom mënu ñu am doom.
Bi may ndaw lañu ma jox xam-xam, àtte ak Mbind mi.
Dama daan topp samay waajur, yërëm ñeneen ñi, te duma réy wala déggal samay waajur.
Yàlla dogal na jàmm ci man bis bi may juddoo ak bis bi may dee ak bis bi may dekki di dund.
Sama pàppa Zakariyya jot na ma xibaar bu neex ci malaaka yi, bimu taxawee di ñaan ci barab bu sell bi (mihrab).

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
